values.note: Muskegon County: campsite fee $52 a day (first Friday in May to last Sunday in September), the same on the booking site for 2026-09-15 and 2027-06-15; no resident/non-resident split. Every vehicle entering the park May 1 - Sept 30 needs a county park pass: $7 a day or $25 for the calendar year.

Day Pass: $7 Seasonal Park Pass: $25') + https://muskegoncountyparks.org/faqs/ + muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com feeDetails ($52 on 2026-09-15 and 2027-06-15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'All reservations must be made online via the reservation website. We do not accept reservations over the phone.' The 2026 season opened for booking on January 2. Cancelling 7+ business days out costs $10; later, the first night or $75, whichever is less.

booking.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/faqs/ ('Reservations for 2026 Camping season can be made on Friday, January 2nd at 8am. All reservations must be made online via the reservation website. We do not accept reservations over the phone.') + https://muskegoncountyparks.org/meinert-park/ ('Make a Reservation' -> muskegoncounty.goingtocamp.com), read 2026-10-22

note: Muskegon County park near Montague (8390 Meinert Park Rd) in 182 acres of forested Lake Michigan dunes along Little Flower Creek; open and shaded sites, several paved, about 2,000 ft from the Lake Michigan beach. A three-bedroom rental cottage. --Claude
summary: County park page + FAQ + GoingToCamp catalog: 67 full-hookup sites (61 at 20/30 A, 6 at 20/50 A), RVs to 45 ft, flush toilets/showers/dump; $52 a day (also 2027), county park pass $7/day or $25/year on top; online-only reservations on GoingToCamp; season first Friday in May to last Sunday in September. Fees confirmed (+ entrance pass), hookups/count/facilities/booking confirmed (now manual), max 45 ft, season added. Note cleaned of hookup/facility/booking text.
